sources.evidence: Hero meta links 'Bengaluru' to the OpenStreetMap feature (title 'Open in OSM Maps'); FAQ: 'held on 26th and 27th September, 2026 at the NIMHANS Convention Centre at Bengaluru, Karnataka'. The public FOSS United event document (raw/event.json) carries the same map_link and map_coordinate.
Participant Guidelines, 'Venue and Facilities': 'Location: NIMHANS Convention Centre, Hosur Road, Bengaluru.'
Organiser Travel and Accommodation Guide, linked as-is. None of its transport advice is imported.

notes: Maintainer selected the OpenStreetMap feature link on 9 September 2026 (issue #278).
The map destination is the building feature the organiser chose. It is not evidence of an entrance, an accessible route, parking or transport; none of those are claimed here.
No physical verification of the venue is claimed. Re-check the source pages and update checkedAt when the organiser changes them.

venue.name: NIMHANS Convention Centre
venue.address: NIMHANS Convention Centre, Hosur Road, Bengaluru
venue.note: The map link marks the venue building as the organiser published it, not a specific entrance.
